result.title: NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026 Keynote With CEO Jensen Huang
result.description: Join NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang live from Berlin for the latest in AI and accelerated computing. Discover how Europe is building its own intelligence—with the control, knowledge, and tools to put AI to work.

result.title: How AI Enables Better, More Connected Patient Care
result.description:
Better care starts when the systems around a doctor and a patient work together. AI connects conversations, lab results, operating room planning, supplies, and recovery support. This gives care teams better information to provide you with what you need. Connected digital tools and AI-powered equipment can help doctors spend more time being your doctor.

result.title: How Lila Sciences’ AI and Automated Labs Help Scientists Discover New Medicines Faster
result.description:
Lila Sciences connects AI agents to an autonomous lab to explore a therapy designed to help a patient’s own immune cells fight B-cell lymphoma. Lila builds an experimental plan using NVIDIA Nemotron and NVIDIA Agent Toolkit, while models built with NVIDIA BioNeMo can run millions of virtual experiments to identify promising candidates for lab testing.
In Lila’s AI Science Factory, robotic instruments make and test those candidates. The results return to inform the next round of designs and experiments.

result.title: RFD4-Proteina: How IPD Researchers and NVIDIA Design New Proteins with AI
result.description:
UW’s Medicine Institute for Protein Design, founded and led by Nobel Laureate David Baker, and NVIDIA Research show how they move AI-generated designs from computer models into lab testing, including work on enzymes that break down pesticides. The team combines protein design research and computational efficiency to explore new approaches to chemistry, medicine and environmental challenges.
